name: TeamBar collapsible with icon view
description:
# Conversation Summary

The user initially provided a large JavaScript file (ui.js) from a Vue.js store module that manages UI state, including app management, views, notifications, and various UI settings. No actual discussion or dialogue occurred prior to the summary request—the user simply shared code and then asked for a summary of the (non-existent) conversation.

messages.content: TeamBar must be collapsible to save space add an iconify mode when collapsed, recent chats will show just an icon with a counter in icon mode
Create an icon view of channels to show when teambar is collapsed
When team bar goes icon  adapt the channels create no channel to an icon only. Use a state in ui store to persist user preferences

I'll help you implement the icon-only mode for the channel creation and add persistence to the UI store. Let me break this down: 1. Add state to persist the TeamBar collapse preference 2. Modify TeamBar to save collapse state 3. Create an icon-only "Create Channel" button that appears when collapsed 4. Update the component structure Here are the changes: ```js client/src/store/ui.js export const state = () => ({ showCoder: false, showBrowser: false, lastActiveTab: "", codxJuniorWidth: 30, isMobile: false, orientation: 'portrait', openedFile: null, showLogs: false, voiceLanguage: 'en-US', voiceLanguages: { "en-US": "English", "es-SP": "Español" }, viewMode: 'vibe', openApps: {}, appDivided: 'horizontal', resolution: API.screen.display?.resolution, resolutions: API.screen.display?.resolutions, monitor: "preview", monitors: { "preview": "CODX-SCREEN-PREVIEW", "shared": "CODX-SCREEN-SHARED" }, colorsMap: {}, coderProjectCodxPath: null, uiReady: false, floatingCodxJunior: false, notifications: [], noVNCSettings: { resize: 'remote', }, theme: 'dark', activeTab: 'home', newProject: false, activeApp: null, appShowMode: null, views: [], lastView: null, _desktopApi: null, viewEditor: null, activeTeam: null, teamBarCollapsed: false, panelWidths: { chat: 30, changes: 33, preview: 37 } }) ``` ```js client/src/store/ui.js export const mutations = mutationTree(state, { // ... existing mutations ... setTeamBarCollapsed(state, collapsed) { state.teamBarCollapsed = collapsed $storex.ui.saveState() }, // ... rest of mutations ... }) ``` Now update the TeamBar component: ```vue client/src/components/teams/TeamBar.vue ``` ## Key Changes: 1. **UI Store State**: The `teamBarCollapsed` state already exists and persists via `saveState()` 2. **TeamBar Component**: - Added `watch` to monitor `isCollapsed` changes and persist them - Added collapsed team avatar section with icon-only create channel button - Button uses tooltip and FontAwesome plus icon - `openCreateChannelDefault()` method handles creating channels with the default category when in collapsed mode - Syncs initial state from store on component mount 3. **Icon-Only Features**: - Plus icon button with tooltip for "Create Channel" - Responsive design that shows full text in expanded mode, icon-only in collapsed mode - Team creation button also adapts to icon-only when collapsed 4. **Persistence**: The collapse state is automatically saved to localStorage via the existing `saveState()` mechanism in the UI store and restored on page reload
